lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in vertical columns of 3-4 units, positioned posterior to the branchial region and superior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Prominent longitudinal ridge running horizontally across the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, discrete high-luminance spots visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin at the dorsal midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple horizontal, linear high-luminance marks located on the upper flank and cephalic region, consistent with superficial abrasions or scarring.
